hint: Browser: open localhost:5002/reservations and click the first row. Expect the 404 page.

label: ask for the page
hint: Paste the prompt below and press Enter. Claude reads Storybook, then writes the page.
prompt: Build the reservation detail page at /reservations/:id. Read Storybook first and use only its components.

label: the new page
hint: When Claude is done: reload the browser and click the first row. Expect the detail page with the conflict banner.

label: ui-check
hint: Paste the command and press Enter. Then /exit, cd ../mvp-dev, start claude.

label: dev session start
hint: Dev repo, branch demo/start, claude is open. The recording keeps running.

label: no detail page in dev
hint: Browser: open localhost:5003/reservations and click the first row. Expect the 404 page in dev too.

label: slice, which page
hint: Paste /slice-vibe and press Enter. When Claude asks which page, answer ReservationDetail.
where: dev Claude: paste, then answer the question

label: slice report
hint: Right after you answer. Claude runs the script and shows the report.
where: dev Claude: wait for the report

label: dev result
hint: Browser: reload localhost:5003 and click the first row. Expect the same detail page, with the banner.

label: part D start
hint: Part D, recorded right after B in the same dev state (the page is sliced, the Timeline was promoted, the report is on screen). Stay on the current branch. Start the screen recording now.
where: nowhere: this terminal is not recorded

label: the finding
hint: Point at the Scan table of the latest slice report: the unknown-prop lines name the component and the property. The proposed-import was already handled by promoting Timeline.
where: screen: the Scan table of the report

label: fix the component
hint: Dev session. The prompt is built from the first unknown-prop in the latest slice report. Paste it and press Enter.

label: pull-ui
hint: Switch to a shell in the vibe repo. Paste the command and press Enter: the promoted Timeline and the fixed component come back into the vibe copy.
prompt: ! npm run pull-ui && npm run ui-check

label: vibe uses the promoted component
hint: Vibe session (start claude in the vibe repo if it is closed). Paste the prompt and press Enter. The page now imports Timeline from components, and the proposed copy is gone.
prompt: pull-ui brought in components that were promoted from src/proposed. For every page that imports from proposed/<name> where src/components/<name> now exists, import from components/<name> instead, then delete the proposed copy. Show what you changed.

label: slice again
hint: Dev session. Expect Conflicts none, proposed-import 0 and unknown-prop 0, exit 0. If Claude asks for a sample, pass --sample /reservations/RS-1001.
